title: Nazmir, the Loa, and G'huun
summary: Talanji's expedition seeks loa allies against blood trolls whose rituals serve G'huun.
opening: Nazmir held the ruins of a great troll past and a growing present danger. Talanji entered the swamp to find allies before its corruption spread.
reviewNote: Separate zone, dungeon, and Uldir raid events; verify the fates of each loa in game. Editorial chapter research tasks retained here: Establish the blood troll threat that Talanji refuses to ignore. Follow appeals to Hi'reek, Bwonsamdi, Torga, and Krag'wa. Trace the route toward the Underrot and its source of infection. Connect the zone crisis to G'huun, with the raid outcome reviewed separately.

chapters.title: Into Nazmir
chapters.body: The blood trolls’ growing threat drew Talanji into Nazmir. Among the swamp’s old ruins, she sought help before its corruption spread.

chapters.title: Seeking the loa
chapters.body: Appeals reached Hi’reek, Bwonsamdi, Torga and Krag’wa. The search for allies carried the expedition among powers whose answers could not be taken for granted.

chapters.title: Corruption below
chapters.body: Below the swamp waited the Underrot. The danger upon the surface pointed toward infection beneath it.

chapters.title: The larger danger
chapters.body: The crisis reached toward G’huun. What the greater confrontation would change remains unfinished in this account.
